title: `record:details` section entries gained eight authorable keys in `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0 with no designer control — deferred feature card (#7122 ruling, item 5)
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`) as the deferred feature card the #7122 ruling requires. ⛔ Unassigned; grading is triage's. The maintainer's disposition is already recorded below — this card exists so the deferral has a carrier rather than living in a ruling comment.

## The measured fact (PR #7685, `aabc527cb`)

At `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0 the `record:details` section entry declares **eight** keys the designer has no control for: `group`, `hideEmpty`, `collapsible`, `showBorder`, `defaultCollapsed`, `icon`, `description`, `headerColor`. The pin that went red at the bump (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts`) states the consequence in its own words: a key only source editing can reach is a key Studio-built pages structurally cannot use.

## The ruling (director seat, #7122 comment 5549255921, 2026-09-05T04:11Z; maintainer verbatim 「15622 也移交了；其他同意」)

> **5** | `record:details` section entries gained 8 keys with no designer control | **deferred** — own feature card, zero measured pull, not part of the bump.

So: eight new designer controls are a **feature**, not bump fallout; under the startup-focus axis it waits for named pull. ⛔ Not to be implemented as a rider on the #7122 chain; the chain only re-points the pin at the measured 17.3.0 truth.

## Two neighbouring cards whose premise this changes — recorded so nobody "fixes" them the old way

- **#7465** (`showBorder` on `record:details` sections — "spec REFUSES it, `@object-ui/types` declares it"): at 17.3.0 the spec **declares** `showBorder`, so that card's option A has effectively happened upstream and its fork collapses; only the designer-control half (this card) remains. Re-verify #7465 on the merged ref before touching it.
- **#7129** (closed) retired `DetailViewSection.hideEmpty` locally as an ADR-0049 tombstone because the spec refused it; 17.3.0 now declares `hideEmpty`. The #7122 chain's dev measures what the tombstone should become at 17.3.0 and reports it — the answer is not assumed here.
